requirements.title: Allowlisted Typed-Job Dispatch
requirements.description: The control plane dispatches typed jobs — {scenario, verb, args} validated against the scenario-CLI manifest — never raw shell strings. Each node grants which verb-namespaces it accepts (e.g. `scenario test*` yes, `secrets*` / `scenario deploy*` no). Execution is constrained to declared operations with per-node permission scopes.

validation.notes: A job whose verb is absent from the manifest or outside the node's scopes is rejected before reaching the node.
The node-agent executes only typed verbs via the local vrooli CLI; it never constructs or runs an arbitrary shell string.
Attempting a non-allowlisted verb on a node is denied and audited; an allowlisted verb succeeds.
